text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I thought this generation was completely 
dominated by Buena. That's why the 
emergence of the Saint, Red Desire, has me 
trembling with excitement...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I was saved by Lady Desire's noble 
presence, charging forward undeterred by 
any hardship."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Please, shine upon this closed world as a 
singularity――!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire read each letter from the fans 
aloud, savoring every single word.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Every single one is written with 
such passionate, heartfelt feelings...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has such high expectations of 
me... and no one else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista declaring her pursuit of the 
Triple Tiara route is likely another 
reason behind all this excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone capable of rivaling the 
dominant Buena Vista, expectations began 
to rise among race fans for Red Desire.
choice_data_list:
(Normally that would be a ton of pressure, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"These expectations, this yearning... Only 
by shouldering all of this can one be a 
true saint!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And the only one who can fulfill this duty 
is me, racing across the turf...!
choice_data_list:
So we've decided on our goals for the 
Classic year, huh.

So we've decided on our goals for the 
Classic year, haven't we.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A once-in-a-lifetime pilgrimage 
toward a beautiful and radiant glory—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I shall challenge the 'Triple Tiara'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara—a title bestowed upon 
the Umamusume who conquers all three 
races: the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the 
Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that Buena Vista has declared her 
entry into the Triple Tiara route, it 
means I have to fight against her as well.
choice_data_list:
(This is going to be an incredibly tough 
road...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Manhattan Cafe once said that 
"fulfillment" is the key to unlocking the 
world Red Desire must reach.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am certain of it. When your heart 
finds true fulfillment... a new door shall 
surely open...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An ordinary victory will never satisfy her 
soul.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only by conquering trials that everyone 
deems impossible with one's own sheer 
strength—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Red Desire will reach the "Other World."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Being born in the same generation as 
Buena-san is unmistakable destiny, and my 
great fortune."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Her strength—her brilliance— is truly this 
world's definition of "special."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"And I will run ahead of her, reaching out 
to touch the door to 'that place.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...This isn't a goal.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is the destiny that Saint Red Desire 
must bear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no objections to the path she 
believed in. Because I knew that's what 
the Saint, Red Desire, would do.
choice_data_list: First, let's win the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"A saint donning the first tiara on a 
grand stage of swirling cherry blossoms— 
Hehe, everyone will be trembling with 
emotion, won't they?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shall surely claim all three shining 
tiaras. They will undoubtedly illuminate 
the path leading to the otherworld with 
vibrant brilliance.
